memories.content: They are responsible for the Apollo program and will decide whether to announce a go decision for Apollo 11's July launch window after the flight readiness review. They have access to technical assessments and schedules.

Apollo 11 is scheduled for a July 1969 launch window. A flight readiness review process is underway to assess readiness. The review is expected to conclude before the end of June 1969. A public announcement of a go decision would be made by senior managers at the conclusion of the review.
